messages.subject: GCC Country Leadership | Industrial Market Entry, Government Relations and Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Semczuk,

JN Recruitment's focus on Country Managers, Managing Directors and regional industrial leadership across the UAE and wider Gulf makes this a relevant confidential introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities bring together senior government and regulatory engagement, corporate and external affairs, ESG, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive coordination across a capital-intensive multinational operation.

My profile is particularly suited to regional market-entry and country-facing roles where an international company needs a senior leader who can build institutional credibility, navigate government interfaces, align external stakeholders and support commercial and operating execution.

I am targeting Country Director or Representative, Regional or Country Leadership, External and Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across industrial technology, infrastructure, energy, resources and related B2B environments. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations, Infrastructure and Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear HRBS Global Team,

Your executive-search coverage across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and wider GCC, including energy, infrastructure, construction, industrial and sustainability leadership, makes this a strong fit for my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder management, executive advisory and country-facing coordination across a major multinational industrial operation.

Across 12+ years, I have worked in multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial environments. My value is strongest where senior leadership must combine institutional credibility, regulation, external relationships, reputation and execution rather than manage them as separate functions.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, Government Relations, External or Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations roles. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
